topPRs.title: feat(standard-versions): add final op-contracts/v7.0.0 and v8.0.0 entries
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Adds the final (non-rc) `op-contracts/v7.0.0` and `op-contracts/v8.0.0` entries to `standard-versions-mainnet.toml` and `standard-versions-sepolia.toml`, keeping the existing rc entries.

## Background

`op-contracts/v8.0.0` was tagged today by @maurelian at the same commit as `v8.0.0-rc.3` (`f45a5cc`); `op-contracts/v7.0.0` exists at the same commit as `v7.0.0-rc.4` (`a7c88c8`) but was never added to the registry. Contracts were not redeployed in either case, so addresses and versions are identical to the rc blocks. 

Releases:
- https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/releases/tag/op-contracts%2Fv7.0.0
- https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/releases/tag/op-contracts%2Fv8.0.0

Supersedes #1338, which renamed the `v8.0.0-rc.3` entry in place instead of adding a new block.

topPRs.title: validation: promote op-contracts/v8.0.0-rc.3 to op-contracts/v8.0.0 in standard versions
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Renames the mainnet and sepolia standard-versions entry `op-contracts/v8.0.0-rc.3` to `op-contracts/v8.0.0`, since the release is being promoted to stable. Contract versions and addresses are unchanged.
